Press Release

 Midiman Forges New Corporate Identity as M-Audio
                               Fastest growing company repositions to meet growing demand
                                                 of expanding product line

ARCADIA, Calif., July 3, 2002 – Ranked by Music Trades magazine as the fastest growing company in the music industry for
the past two consecutive years, Midiman has changed its corporate moniker to M-Audio—the name it has been using for its
Audio Division since 1999. This re-branding comes as an acknowledgement of the Company’s highly successful expansion
into a broad range of product categories related to musical performance, recording and pro audio. The Midiman product line
will remain available through M-Audio.

“Midiman and M-Audio both have great brand recognition,” acknowledges Adam Castillo, Marketing Director of M-Audio. “The
fact is that the name M-Audio better reflects our expanded product lines and future directions as a company. Given our
continued growth and diversification of products, we felt that this was a logical time to make the transition.”

With sales expanding more than 190% in the last two years, M-Audio has seen great success in part because it has
consistently parlayed its advanced technology into products that outperform the competition at lower prices. M-Audio has both
expanded its own product lines and selected key products to distribute in order to provide its customers with all the core
elements of today’s computer-centric studio. M-Audio’s mission of “Redefining the Studio” delivers new levels of control,
virtualization and mobility that transform the way musicians compose, perform and live their creative lives.

The Company started making niche MIDI products in 1988 and experienced a significant growth as it began to focus on the
nascent desktop recording market in 1997. Since then, M-Audio has brought dozens of new digital audio products to market—
including the critically acclaimed Delta audio card series —and sells more audio cards than any of its competitors.

M-Audio has a string of best-selling products that straddle diverse categories such as software (Propellerhead’s Reason),
keyboards (Oxygen8 USB MIDI controller), speakers (Studiophile SP-5B), and audio cards (Audiophile 2496—named Audio
Card of the Year by Computer Music magazine). The Company recently began distributing several other best-of-breed
products including Ableton’s Live software and the renowned Groove Tubes microphone line.

M-Audio also enjoys numerous OEM relationships, supplying products to many leading companies in the industry. The
Company has also recently launched a product line that brings professional-quality audio products to the consumer electronics
market. M-Audio currently owns its own distribution operations in the US, the UK, Germany, Japan, Canada, and France.
